title: Airbnb: Search, Calendar Management, and Pricing Rules
description: Add date-range search, blocked calendars, and dynamic pricing.

data.text: Add property search with filters, calendar availability management, and dynamic pricing based on demand and season.

data.title: PropertySearch and Calendar
Search at scale
data.text: For millions of properties, use Elasticsearch or Algolia. PostgreSQL with GIN indexes works for smaller datasets. Pre-compute availability calendars for fast filtering.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Search filters by location, date overlap, price, and amenities
Dynamic pricing adjusts for weekends and stay length
data.takeaway: Airbnb search is a range-query problem. Keep availability as derived data from confirmed bookings, and price dynamically to maximize occupancy.
